name: nhost-vsme
description: Project guidance for using Nhost instead of Supabase in the VSME Supplier Passport app.

interface.shortDescription: Guides this project toward Nhost auth, GraphQL, storage, and server integrations.
interface.longDescription: A repo-local Codex plugin for migrating or implementing VSME Supplier Passport data, authentication, document storage, and share-link workflows with Nhost instead of Supabase.
defaultPrompt: Use Nhost for auth, GraphQL, and storage in this VSME Supplier Passport project.
Audit this app for Supabase assumptions and replace them with Nhost patterns.
Add a Next.js data layer for VSME Supplier Passport backed by Nhost GraphQL.
